enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +9: Passive: +9 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Upgradeable Item (Temple of Elemental Evil): This item can be upgraded. Bring this item to the Overgrown Workbench in the Temple of Elemental Evil and combine it with Rusty Gilled Mushrooms to upgrade the item to a more powerful form.

children.tooltip: Spell Penetration I: Passive: +1 Equipment bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Riposte I: When Missed by an attack: Deals 1 to 4 damage to your attacker. Passive: +1 Insight bonus to Armor Class.
Fire Lore III: Passive: Your Fire spells gain a 13% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.

enchantments.tooltip: Combustion +54: Passive: +54 Equipment bonus to Fire Spell Power.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
